title: Newer or older?
description:
Compare 16-bit sequence numbers that wrap around.

```
newer(2, 1) = true
newer(1, 65535) = true   (65535 then 0 then 1)
newer(65535, 1) = false
newer(32768, 0) = false  (exactly half way: treated as older)
```
hints: Integer promotion turns `a - b` into an `int`, so the subtraction itself cannot wrap here.
requirements: `bool newer(std::uint16_t a, std::uint16_t b)` as in the lesson's formula.
Test the edge cases above and a few of your own.
stretch: Write `difference(a, b)` that gives a signed distance (-32768 to 32767).
